concepts.label: Java SDK source/binary license (Apache License, Version 2.0)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - no existing concept covers the SDK's own source/binary licensing terms

concepts.label: Java SDK documentation license (Creative Commons CC-BY-NC-SA)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - distinct from sdk:source-license; the docs' source carries a different license than the SDK's own source/binaries

concepts.label: Support level (tied to the Enterprise or Community Couchbase Cluster license agreement in use)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - no existing concept covers the mapping between cluster license agreement and SDK support level

relations.subject: sdk:source-license
relations.evidence: Source and any and all binaries for the Couchbase Java Client are distributed under the [Apache License, Version 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).

relations.subject: sdk:documentation-license
relations.evidence: The docs' source is licensed under the Creative Commons [CC-by-NC-SA](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/deed.en) license

relations.subject: sdk:support-level
relations.evidence: Support level will match the terms of your use of your Couchbase Cluster(s), under Couchbase's Enterprise or Community license agreements.

relations.subject: edition:enterprise
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - predicate is promoted; two differently-named plans that carry the identical support-level guarantee
relations.evidence: [Enterprise License Agreement](https://www.couchbase.com/license-agreement/) — this support level also applies to users of Capella Operational.

relations.subject: edition:community
relations.evidence: [Community License Agreement](https://www.couchbase.com/community-license-agreement/) — this support level also applies to users of Capella Free Tier.

notable_absence.finding: The Dependencies section ('Any dependencies may have their own, separate licenses') links to a generic third-party-components legal page with no per-dependency detail on this page itself - nothing to extract beyond the generic pointer, which is not a Couchbase-doc-tree structural link (it targets couchbase.com/legal, not another SDK doc page), so no seeAlso relation was added for it.

cross_component_finding: The edition-to-Capella-plan mapping (edition:enterprise <-> Capella Operational, edition:community <-> Capella Free Tier) is stated here purely in support-level terms, not in feature-availability terms - this page makes no claim that Capella Operational unlocks Enterprise-only features, only that its support entitlement matches the Enterprise license agreement. That's a narrower claim than the edition-gating relations (requiresEdition, behavesDifferentlyUnder) used elsewhere in the corpus for actual feature gates, and should not be conflated with them at reconciliation.
